recent.text: Congratulations to @NYIslanders one and only stalwart center #CaseyCizikas on his milestone 1,000th game with the Nassaumen. Added a key assist in BIG win over Detroit. Casey has embraced and embodied Isles spirit from his first game at Ye Olde Coliseum. YAY, CASEY!!

recent.text: That's #Isles first win with Pulock out of the lineup this season. They were 0-2-2 during his four-game absence previously. Thought structure tonight was fantastic. Stanley looked sharp in his return & credit to Hutton & Kessel for the way they played. Team effort.

recent.text: Per #NHL Stats: #Isles Matthew Schaefer (0-2—2) potted his 18th career multi-point game and overtook Ray Bourque (17) for the second-most by a teenage defenseman in NHL history. Phil Housley (34) tops the list.
recent.author: Stefen Rosner

recent.text: The story from Detroit as #Isles edge #RedWings 3-2 in Casey Cizikas' 1,000th game w/fourth-liner Ondrej Palat fittingly scoring twice and Ilya Sorokin being, well, Ilya Sorokin when he had to be (will be updated w/quotes) https://t.co/TBRQMkW3FP https://t.co/TBRQMkW3FP
recent.author: Andrew Gross

recent.text: Casey Cizikas on the #Isles continuing to find ways to earn points: “We’re relentless in here.” Praised the team’s response when Detroit pushed back and Sorokin’s performance. “He made some unbelievable saves back there.” (H/t @IslesMSGN)
recent.author: Stefen Rosner

recent.text: Casey Cizikas on celebrating his 1,000th NHL game with his family in attendance: “Getting the two points is all we could have asked for.” Called the #Isles taking three of four points to finish the road trip “massive.” “It’s just been special.” (H/t @IslesMSGN)
recent.author: Stefen Rosner

recent.text: #Isles Casey Cizikas on the emotions when the final buzzer sounded in his 1,000th NHL game: “It was surreal.” “I can’t say enough about the guys in this locker room, the way they worked tonight.” (H/t @IslesMSGN)
recent.author: Stefen Rosner

recent.text: Casey Cizikas on his #Isles teammates after his 1,000th NHL game: “These guys mean everything to me, and I’m just so grateful for them all.” Said what his teammates did for him tonight is tough to put into words. (H/t @IslesMSGN)
recent.author: Stefen Rosner

recent.text: #Isles Casey Cizikas: "It's the support I've felt over these last 24 hours. It doesn't go unnoticed and I had a lot of family and friends drive down for this game and it means the world to me. It means the world to me to have my wife, my kids here, parents, in-laws. Everyone."
recent.author: Andrew Gross

recent.text: #Isles Pete DeBoer says he did give a sigh of relief when Emil Heineman came out for the third. He thought, "Here we go again" because he thought Heineman had clutched at his shoulder. DeBoer still wants to see how Heineman feels on Monday.
recent.author: Andrew Gross

recent.text: Pete DeBoer on Simon Holmstrom: “He’s just playing with a lot of confidence.” DeBoer praised Holmstrom’s work at both ends of the rink and how the #Isles are relying on him in all situations, including the PP and PK. (H/t @IslesMSGN )
recent.author: Stefen Rosner

recent.text: Pete DeBoer on Bo Horvat: “I think Bo doesn’t get enough credit for what he’s doing.” Said Horvat is driving offense even when he’s not scoring, using his size and strength to win pucks back and create turnovers. #Isles (H/t @IslesMSGN)
recent.author: Stefen Rosner

recent.text: Pete DeBoer on how fitting it was that the #Isles fourth line scored twice in Casey Cizikas’ 1,000th NHL game: “It was probably a testament to his 1,000th game even more than the type of game it was that our fourth line got two goals.” (H/t @IslesMSGN)
recent.author: Stefen Rosner
